claims.quote: EA1 and EA2 are most frequently encountered, caused by mutations in KCNA1 and CACNA1A.
Advances in genetic testing have broadened the KCNA1 and CACNA1A phenotypes, and detected EA as an unusual presentation of several other genetic disorders.

claims.object_text: other paroxysmal disorders of childhood with chronic neuropsychiatric features
claims.quote: EA2 may be accompanied by other paroxysmal disorders of childhood with chronic neuropsychiatric features.
New treatments for EA2 include dalfampridine and fampridine, in addition to 4-aminopyridine and acetazolamide.
